en-US.description: A terminal for keeping track of all the information from your Claude Code sessions.
en-US.longDescription: Windows terminal for Claude Code. Shows context usage, cost, git status and recent chats for each session, notifies when a session finishes or waits for permission, and restores tabs on restart.
